change: Canonical and original-ID alias GitHub pull-request merge share one explicit boolean classifier after provider schema validation. HTTP200 merged=false returns409 executed=false with provider_attempted=true and terminal failed receipt. Malformed/lost/upstream5xx/persistence ambiguity returns executed=null and reconciliation_required=true with no second provider write.
scope: Existing canonical github.pull_requests.merge and github.merge alias only; no other default behavior changed.
